Text.label:
Col and Row are 'enable' pins. 
Both must be set to 1 for this 1 Byte memory to respond to the other inputs.
This design is to facilitate the incorporation of this component into a grid layout.

constructorParamaters:
Col and Row are 'enable' pins. 
Both must be set to 1 for this 1 Byte memory to respond to the other inputs.
This design is to facilitate the incorporation of this component into a grid layout.

Text.label:
Reset sets all 8-bits to 0.
It is asynchronous and does not require Write to be set to 1.

constructorParamaters:
Reset sets all 8-bits to 0.
It is asynchronous and does not require Write to be set to 1.

Text.label:
A tri-state buffer is used so that when this memory cell is not enabled,
its output will be the Z (high impedance) state.

constructorParamaters:
A tri-state buffer is used so that when this memory cell is not enabled,
its output will be the Z (high impedance) state.

Text.label:
Write, which just connects to the Clock input of the D-type flip-flop,
is triggered by a positive 'edge' - i.e. the input changing from 0 to 1.
 The D_in, Col & Row, inputs must be set up before write is set to 1.

constructorParamaters:
Write, which just connects to the Clock input of the D-type flip-flop,
is triggered by a positive 'edge' - i.e. the input changing from 0 to 1.
 The D_in, Col & Row, inputs must be set up before write is set to 1.

Text.label: The 4-bit address is split into 2 groups of 2 bits, represeniting the row and column addrresses, within this grid of 16 elements.

constructorParamaters: The 4-bit address is split into 2 groups of 2 bits, represeniting the row and column addrresses, within this grid of 16 elements.

Text.label: Each 2-bit address is decoded into four separate lines, which connect to the individual columns and rows in the grid.

constructorParamaters: Each 2-bit address is decoded into four separate lines, which connect to the individual columns and rows in the grid.

Text.label: Reset connects to the Reset pin on each memory cell in the grid.

constructorParamaters: Reset connects to the Reset pin on each memory cell in the grid.

Text.label:
D_out merges the D_out from each memory cell. 
However, the Col and Row selectors will ensure that only the memory cell 
being addressed will produce an output. 
The others will be in Z (high impedance) state.

constructorParamaters:
D_out merges the D_out from each memory cell.

being addressed will produce an output. 
The others will be in Z (high impedance) state.

Text.label:
D_in is connected to the D_in of each memory cell. 
However, only the single cell that has both its Col and Row inputs 
enabled will write the value when the Write input changes from 0 to 1.

constructorParamaters:
D_in is connected to the D_in of each memory cell. 
However, only the single cell that has both its Col and Row inputs 
enabled will write the value when the Write input changes from 0 to 1.

Text.label:
This 16 byte circuit has its own Col and Row Enable pins. 
Both of these must be set to 1 for this circuit to be active.
 If either is 0, no cell within the  grid will be enabled. 
This is so that this 16 byte circuit can, in turn, be built into a grid.
